messages: Your child's hemoglobin is in the healthy range for this age. Keep up the iron-rich meals.
Good news — hemoglobin looks normal for a child. Continue age-appropriate nutrition.
Iron levels look healthy. Keep offering iron-rich foods with vitamin C.
Hemoglobin is slightly low for a child. Add iron-rich foods like moringa, jaggery, and dal.
Mild anemia for this age band. Pair green leafy vegetables with lemon or tomato.
Iron needs a small boost. Try moringa powder in porridge and citrus with meals.
Hemoglobin needs attention. Please take the child to a PHC and focus on iron-rich foods.
Moderate anemia for this age. Visit a healthcare provider soon and increase dietary iron.
Iron levels are concerning. See a doctor this week; do not start supplements unless advised.
Hemoglobin is very low. Please take the child to a doctor or PHC today.
Severe anemia detected. Urgent medical attention needed — visit a hospital or PHC today.
Critical iron deficiency. Do not delay — consult a healthcare provider right away.
